description: P0.0 communication fault fixtures: deterministic scenarios the fixture child (tests/fixtures/ui/fake_server.py) can arm via argv --fault/--fault-delay or the bench/set-fault request. Consumed by the P0.1 deadline/cleanup tests; P0.0 pins the modes, verifies arming, and exercises blocked-drain for real (OS pipe backpressure gates the client drain). No model calls, no network.

scenarios.description: the child stops reading stdin for delay_s: the OS pipe fills and a large client write genuinely blocks inside drain() (verified by the clock-section blocked_drain probe)
the first reply after spawn is delayed, modeling slow initialize / session-create startup
turn events are delayed after session/send or turn/start while the drain loop polls
the turn never completes (intermediate events keep streaming); the caller cancels while the event-drain poll loop waits
session/send is accepted but completion is withheld; cancellation lands after dispatch
initialize is accepted but never answered; proves the caller-side start bound (bench_fake_appserver start_timeout)
